next.reason: 1985: "Record-name-1 and identifier-1 must not refer to the same storage area."; 2023: "14.6.10, Overlapping operands, and 14.9.25, MOVE statement, general rules, apply to any cases in which ... share any part". 1985 refuses programs where the operands share storage. 2023 has no such syntax rule and accepts them, with the result governed by the overlapping-operand and MOVE rules.
